title: The group $\mathrm{TK}_1$ of graded and valued division algebras
summary: For a division algebra $D$, let $K_1(D) = D^*/[D^*, D^*]$ and let $\operatorname{TK}_1(D)$ be the torsion subgroup of the abelian group $K_1(D)$. We study this torsion group for graded and valued division algebras, in parallel with the known theory of $\operatorname{SK}_1$. For a graded division algebra $E$ finite-dimensional over its center, we give exact sequences describing $\operatorname{TK}_1(E)$ in terms of $E_0$, the grade group~$Γ_E$, and the conjugation action of $E^*$ on $E_0$.
